name: mycrew-pipeline
description: Layer 2/5 of the mycrew harness — the build pipeline. Five stage skills that carry one task from a decision to hardened code: /how-to-do (decide a fork), /do (build it by a tight set of writing rules), then /refactor, /review, /test to harden and ship it. Skills only. Built on mycrew-tools; driven by mycrew-worker.
